# Abilities

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## activated

An activated ability: announce it, choose targets, pay its costs, then it goes on the stack. `timing: "sorcery"` restricts it to sorcery speed, `"your_turn"` to your turns; `limit: "once_each_turn"` to one activation per turn, `"once"` to one activation for as long as the object exists; `only_if` to when a condition holds. `zone` ("exile", "graveyard" or "hand") makes it function only while its card is in that zone ("activate only if this card is exiled"). `exhaust: true` makes it an exhaust ability: it can be activated only once (CR 702.177a). `power_up: true` makes it a power-up ability: activate only once, and if the permanent entered this turn its cost is reduced by the permanent's mana cost (CR 702.193). `boast: true`: activate only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn (CR 702.142a).

Rules: CR 602.1, CR 602.2, CR 602.5b, CR 602.5d, CR 702.177a, CR 702.193a, CR 702.193b, CR 702.142a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs (tap, {"mana": "{1}"}, {"mana": "{X}"}) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `timing` | "instant" (default), "sorcery" or "your_turn" |
| `limit` | "once_each_turn" | "once" (CR 602.5b) |
| `only_if` | condition ("activate only if ...") |
| `exhaust` | true: "Exhaust — [cost]: [effect]", activate only once (CR 702.177a) |
| `power_up` | true: "Power-up — [cost]: [effect]" (CR 702.193a) |
| `boast` | true: "Boast — [cost]: [effect]" (CR 702.142a) |
| `zone` | "exile" | "graveyard" | "hand" (CR 113.6b; default: the battlefield, or the zone a cost moves the card from) |
| `cost_reduction` | {"amount": amount, "if": condition}: "this ability costs {N} less to activate" (CR 601.2f, 602.2b) |

```json
{
  "activated": {
    "cost": [
      "tap"
    ],
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 1,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## additional_cost

As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay `cost` too (mana and/or chosen costs such as `sacrifice_permanent`). The spell can't be cast without it. `optional: true`: you may pay it (announced with the `choose_kicker` decision); the condition `{"cast_with": "additional_cost"}` then holds (the spell isn't kicked).

Rules: CR 601.2b, CR 601.2f, CR 601.2h, CR 118.8, CR 118.8b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs |
| `optional` | true: you may pay it |

```json
{
  "additional_cost": {
    "cost": [
      {
        "sacrifice_permanent": {
          "filter": "creature"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## additional_land_plays

Its controller may play an additional land on each of their turns. Each instance adds one land play (CR 305.2); lands put onto the battlefield by effects don't count.

Rules: CR 305.2, CR 305.2a, CR 305.2b, CR 604.1

```json
"additional_land_plays"
```

## additional_triggers

While this permanent is on the battlefield, a triggered ability of a permanent its controller controls that triggers because of `cause` triggers an additional time. `cause`: you_gain_life (its controller gaining life).

Rules: CR 603.2d, CR 119.9

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cause` | you_gain_life |

```json
{
  "additional_triggers": {
    "cause": "you_gain_life"
  }
}
```

## beam_me_up

You may cast this instant or sorcery card from your graveyard for `cost` plus returning a creature you control to its owner's hand, instead of its mana cost. If you do, it's exiled whenever it would leave the stack. Offered as a cast option with `via: "beam:<ref>"`.

Rules: CR 702.196a, CR 702.196b, CR 118.9, CR 601.2b, CR 601.2f, CR 601.2h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{3}{W}" |

```json
{
  "beam_me_up": {
    "cost": "{3}{W}"
  }
}
```

## can_block_only

This creature can block only attacking creatures matching `filter` (checked as blockers are declared, with their current characteristics; controller-relative filter keys are seen from this creature's controller).

Rules: CR 509.1b, CR 509.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | a creature filter, e.g. {"creature": {"keywords": ["flying"]}} |

```json
{
  "can_block_only": {
    "filter": {
      "creature": {
        "keywords": [
          "flying"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## chapter

A Saga's chapter ability: triggers when lore counters put on it bring their number from below `chapter` to at least `chapter`. Its targets are chosen as it's put on the stack. A Saga's final chapter number is its greatest `chapter`.

Rules: CR 715.2, CR 715.2b, CR 715.2c, CR 715.2d, CR 122.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `chapter` | integer >= 1 (the chapter symbol's number) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `modes` | optional modes, as for a spell |

```json
{
  "chapter": {
    "chapter": 2,
    "effects": [
      {
        "gain_life": {
          "amount": 3
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## class_level

A class level bar: `cost` (a mana cost string or a list of costs): this permanent's level becomes `level`; activate only if its level is `level` - 1, as a sorcery. While its level is `level` or greater it has `keywords` and `abilities`. A permanent without a level is level 1.

Rules: CR 717.2a, CR 717.2b, CR 717.2d, CR 717.3, CR 602.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `level` | integer >= 2 |
| `cost` | mana cost string or list of costs |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |
| `abilities` | list of abilities |

```json
{
  "class_level": {
    "level": 2,
    "cost": "{1}{R}",
    "abilities": [
      {
        "triggered": {
          "when": {
            "discards": {}
          },
          "effects": [
            {
              "deal_damage": {
                "amount": 2,
                "to": "each_opponent"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## cost_modifier

While on the battlefield: spells cast by `caster` (you, opponent or any; default you) whose card types match `spells` ({"any_of": [types], "not": [types]}, default all spells) cost `reduce` less or `increase` more generic mana. `from` / `not_from`: only spells cast from (not from) that zone (hand | graveyard | exile | library | outside).

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 604.1, CR 601.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spells` | {"any_of": [types], "not": [types]} (optional) |
| `caster` | you | opponent | any |
| `reduce` | amount |
| `increase` | amount |
| `from` | zone |
| `not_from` | zone |

```json
{
  "cost_modifier": {
    "spells": {
      "not": [
        "creature"
      ]
    },
    "reduce": 1
  }
}
```

## cost_reduction

This spell costs `amount` generic mana less to cast, if the optional `if` condition holds when its total cost is determined (after targets are chosen). `amount` may be computed, e.g. {"count": {"each": "artifact", "controller": "you"}} for affinity for artifacts (CR 702.41a). It can't reduce colored mana or go below {0}.

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 702.41a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount (integer or computed) |
| `if` | condition (optional) |

```json
{
  "cost_reduction": {
    "amount": 1,
    "if": {
      "attacked": true
    }
  }
}
```

## crew

Crew N: tap any number of other untapped creatures you control with total power N or more (chosen one at a time; `done` once the total is enough): this permanent becomes an artifact creature until end of turn. A Vehicle has its printed power and toughness only while it's a creature.

Rules: CR 702.122a, CR 702.122b, CR 702.122e, CR 301.7, CR 301.7a, CR 301.7b, CR 208.3, CR 302.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `power` | integer >= 1 (the N of crew N) |

```json
{
  "crew": {
    "power": 3
  }
}
```

## cycling

Cycling: pay `cost` and discard this card from your hand to draw a card. With `for` it is typecycling: instead search your library for a card matching `for`, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Rules: CR 702.29a, CR 702.29b, CR 702.29e, CR 702.29f, CR 113.6m, CR 602.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{2}" |
| `for` | optional card spec for typecycling (see search_library) |

```json
{
  "cycling": {
    "cost": "{2}",
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## damage_replacement

While this permanent is on the battlefield, damage from sources in `by` to recipients in `to` (both optional; `combat`: combat | noncombat) is changed: `multiply` (2 = "double that damage"), `plus` an amount ("that much damage plus 1"), or `redirect` ("self" | "attached": dealt to this permanent or the one it's attached to instead). A scope is "self", "attached" or {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": bool}; `each` is optional and players match too, so {"controller": "opponent"} is "an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls". Several apply in the order the affected player would pick: redirections, then prevention, then multiplying, then adding.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.5, CR 614.9, CR 616.1, CR 616.1e, CR 616.1f, CR 120.2b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `by` | damage scope |
| `to` | damage scope |
| `combat` | combat | noncombat |
| `multiply` | integer >= 2 |
| `plus` | amount |
| `redirect` | "self" | "attached" |

```json
{
  "damage_replacement": {
    "by": {
      "controller": "you"
    },
    "to": {
      "controller": "opponent"
    },
    "multiply": 2
  }
}
```

## damage_unpreventable

While this permanent is on the battlefield, damage from sources in `by` to recipients in `to` (both optional; `combat`: combat | noncombat) can't be prevented: prevention effects don't reduce it and shields aren't used up.

Rules: CR 615.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `by` | damage scope |
| `to` | damage scope |
| `combat` | combat | noncombat |

```json
{
  "damage_unpreventable": {
    "combat": "combat"
  }
}
```

## destroy_replacement

If a permanent matching `affects` would be destroyed (by an effect, lethal damage or deathtouch), instead: all its `remove_counters` counters are removed (if given) and, with `remove_damage: true`, all damage marked on it is removed. Sacrificing isn't destroying, and 0 toughness isn't either.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.8, CR 701.8a, CR 701.21a, CR 704.5f, CR 704.5g, CR 704.5h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |
| `remove_counters` | counter name |
| `remove_damage` | boolean |

```json
{
  "destroy_replacement": {
    "affects": {
      "each": {
        "creature": {
          "counters": "+1/+1"
        }
      },
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    },
    "remove_counters": "+1/+1",
    "remove_damage": true
  }
}
```

## double_counters

While this permanent is on the battlefield, if its controller would put one or more counters (only `counter`, if given) on a permanent matching `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any}, relative to this permanent's controller), the number put is doubled. This includes counters a permanent enters with.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 122.6, CR 122.6a, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ...} |
| `counter` | optional counter name |

```json
{
  "double_counters": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## double_tokens

While this permanent is on the battlefield, if tokens would be created under its controller's control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead. Several apply one after another (two make four times as many).

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.5, CR 111.1, CR 616.1

```json
"double_tokens"
```

While this permanent is on the battlefield, each time its controller would draw a card, they draw `amount` cards instead (even with an empty library). The draws it makes aren't replaced by it again, but another such effect applies to each of them.

Rules: CR 614.11, CR 614.11a, CR 614.5, CR 121.2, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer >= 2 |

```json

  "draw_replacement": {
    "amount": 2
  }
}
```

## enchant

The Aura's enchant ability: a target filter for what its spell targets and what the Aura may be attached to, e.g. "creature" or {"permanent": {"any_of": ["artifact", "creature"]}}. Only Auras have it.

Rules: CR 702.5a, CR 115.1b, CR 303.4a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | a target filter for a permanent |

```json
{
  "enchant": "creature"
}
```

## enter_as_copy

As this permanent enters, its controller may choose a permanent on the battlefield matching `of`; it enters as a copy of that permanent (its copiable values, with the `except` modifications) and its enter abilities trigger. `with_counters: true`: it also enters with the counters the copied permanent has. Choosing none: it enters as itself.

Rules: CR 707.5, CR 707.9b, CR 614.1c, CR 614.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `of` | filter (the permanents it may copy) |
| `except` | {"legendary": false, "keywords": [...], "types": [...], "subtypes": [...], "supertypes": [...], "name": ..., "power": n, "toughness": n, "colors": [...]} |
| `with_counters` | boolean |

```json
{
  "enter_as_copy": {
    "of": {
      "permanent": {
        "any_of": [
          "artifact",
          "creature"
        ]
      }
    },
    "except": {
      "legendary": false
    },
    "with_counters": true
  }
}
```

## enters_attacking

While this permanent's controller controls an attacking creature, permanents matching `affects` enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (the defending player). They never "attacked", so attack triggers don't see them.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 508.4, CR 506.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any} |

```json
{
  "enters_attacking": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## enters_with_counters

Without `affects`: this permanent enters with the `counters` on it; a count may be an amount computed as it enters (e.g. the mana spent to cast it, CR 601.2h). With `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true}, relative to this permanent's controller): while this permanent is on the battlefield, each matching permanent enters with the `counters` in addition to any others.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counters` | {counter name: n} (n >= 1; without `affects`, n may be an amount) |
| `affects` | optional {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |

```json
{
  "enters_with_counters": {
    "counters": {
      "+1/+1": 1
    },
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true

  }
}
```

## exile_if_dies

While this permanent is on the battlefield, a permanent matching `affects` that would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield is exiled instead; the card is "exiled with" this permanent (exiled_with). `then`: effects right after ("instead exile it and you gain 2 life"; a reflexive_trigger for "When you do, ..."), reading {"triggering": "object"} (the exiled card) and "player" (who controlled it).

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 700.4, CR 603.12, CR 607.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": bool} |
| `then` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "exile_if_dies": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "opponent"
    }
  }
}
```

## mana

An activated mana ability: pay the cost, add the mana to your mana pool immediately. It does not use the stack and can be activated whenever you have priority. `produce`: the fixed mana (`amount` times). Or `color`: `amount` mana (default 1) of one color you choose as you activate it (`"any_one"`) or in any combination of colors (`"any"`); `colors` limits the choice. `"chosen"`: of the color chosen as this entered (choose_color). `spend_only` restricts how the mana can be spent. `only_if`: "Activate only if ...".

## player_rule

While this permanent is on the battlefield (and its `if` condition holds), `rule` applies to the players in `affects` (you | opponents | each; default you). Rules: hexproof, cant_attack, no_max_hand_size, prevent_all_damage, cant_lose_for_life, cant_sacrifice, cant_cast, cant_cast_except_from_hand, spells_cant_be_countered, abilities_cant_be_countered, cant_gain_life, cant_activate, damage_cant_be_prevented, combat_damage_cant_be_prevented, protection_from_opponents. `cant_sacrifice` takes a `filter` of the permanents that can't be sacrificed, `cant_activate` may take a `filter` of the sources whose abilities can't be activated (mana abilities still can), and `cant_cast` and `spells_cant_be_countered` may take a card spec of the `spells`. The damage rules apply to all damage whichever players they name.

Rules: CR 702.11c, CR 115.4, CR 508.1c, CR 402.2, CR 514.1, CR 615.1, CR 615.1a, CR 704.5a, CR 104.3b, CR 701.21a, CR 614.17b, CR 101.2, CR 601.3, CR 701.6a, CR 119.7, CR 602.5, CR 615.12, CR 702.16b, CR 702.16e, CR 702.16k, CR 604.1, CR 604.2, CR 611.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `rule` | hexproof | cant_attack | no_max_hand_size | prevent_all_damage | cant_lose_for_life | cant_sacrifice | cant_cast | cant_cast_except_from_hand | spells_cant_be_countered | abilities_cant_be_countered | cant_gain_life | cant_activate | damage_cant_be_prevented | combat_damage_cant_be_prevented | protection_from_opponents |
| `affects` | you | opponents | each |
| `filter` | permanent filter (cant_sacrifice, cant_activate) |
| `spells` | card spec of the spells (cant_cast, spells_cant_be_countered) |
| `if` | condition ("during your turn": {"your_turn": true}) |

```json
{
  "player_rule": {
    "rule": "cant_cast",
    "affects": "opponents",
    "if": {
      "your_turn": true
    }
  }
}
```

## static

While its source is on the battlefield (and its `if` condition holds), every permanent it `affects` gets `pump` (fixed or computed amounts, layer 7c), the `keywords` and granted `abilities` (layer 6, triggered, activated or mana abilities), and with `creature_types` has exactly those creature types (layer 4); `loses_abilities: true` removes the abilities it had before (layer 6, in timestamp order: later grants and keyword counters stay, CR 613.7), `colors` sets its colors (layer 5) and `base_power_toughness` its base power and toughness (layer 7b); `types` are card types it has in addition to its other types ("this Vehicle is an artifact creature", layer 4) and `subtypes` subtypes it has in addition to its other types ("is a Wizard in addition to its other types", layer 4). `affects` is {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true} (relative to the source's controller), "self", or "attached" ("equipped/enchanted creature").

Rules: CR 604.1, CR 604.2, CR 611.3a, CR 612.8, CR 613.1c, CR 613.1d, CR 613.1e, CR 613.1f, CR 613.4b, CR 613.4c, CR 613.7a, CR 613.8a, CR 205.1a, CR 205.1b, CR 301.5f, CR 303.4m

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool}, "self" or "attached" |
| `if` | condition ("as long as ...", "during your turn") |
| `pump` | {"power": amount, "toughness": amount} ("gets +1/+1 for each ...") |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |
| `creature_types` | list of creature types (replaces the others) |
| `types` | list of card types it also has (in addition to its other types) |
| `subtypes` | list of subtypes it also has (in addition to its other types), or "chosen": the type chosen as its source entered |
| `abilities` | list of triggered, activated or mana abilities the affected permanents have |
| `loses_abilities` | true: it loses all abilities ("loses all abilities") |
| `colors` | list of W, U, B, R, G: its colors are exactly these ([] for colorless) |
| `base_power_toughness` | {"power": n, "toughness": n} |
| `set_types` | list of card types: its card types are exactly these |
| `name` | its name ("named Humble Merchant") |

```json
{
  "static": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    },
    "pump": {
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```
